description: Registrar General's Department - The List of Notaries in Sri Lanka - 31st December - 2018
reasoning: This gazette content contains a list of notaries public with their judicial division, main office location, date of appointment, and languages they practice. Notaries public are judicial officers appointed by the judiciary to perform specific legal functions, particularly related to authentication of documents. This falls under judicial/law enforcement matters as it involves the appointment and registration of legal professionals who serve in an official capacity within the judicial system.
